$comment: THE AGENT TOOL REVIEW — OUR SWITCH. The crawler (scripts/agent-crawl.mjs) finds every function the app can call.
With default_on, every one is offered to the agent EXCEPT those under never (plumbing, the shopper's side,
a device's own, the agent's own door, and what is too final for a chat). Those listed under tools are
reviewed: a title, what each argument means, and the signature reviewed at — a reviewed function whose
arguments change is switched off until it is reviewed again; enabled false there switches one off.
Under ours, each shop has its own switch (Settings → WhatsApp → What the agent may do, store_agent_tools).
The person's permissions still apply, and every change still waits for their YES.
Arguments the shop is (p_store_id) or the server makes (p_client_uuid) are filled in by the gateway.

never.close_store: closes the whole shop: done in the app
